**Date:** November 17, 2026 at 15:35 UTC · **Presenter:** Lwin Ravendo · **Type:** Hands-on Lab (1 hour 37 minutes)

## What we covered

- **Agentic AI Under the Hood:** Loop structure, tool calls, and how intelligence emerges from iteration
- **Agent Architectures:** Independent, decentralized, centralized, and hybrid agent patterns
- **Quro Development Environment:** Web IDE, CLI, local setup with multi-agent workflows
- **Multi-Agent Session Management:** Coordinating parallel development tasks with shared workspace context
- **Context Window Expansion:** From 8K tokens (2025) to 10M tokens (2026) — massive capability increase
- **Real Project Example:** Building cloud-native architecture with coordinated agents for backend, frontend, testing, documentation
- **Cost Management:** Token economics, model selection tradeoffs, budget optimization
- **Error Handling & Recovery:** Git checkpoints, rollback techniques, handling sandbox issues
- **Production Deployment:** Complete flow from specification to deployment with proper validation

## Key takeaway

> Understanding the agentic loop is the foundation. Workspace context matters. Multi-agent coordination requires planning. Cost and speed are tradeoffs. Human oversight remains critical.
